summary: VisionSys AI Inc, a Hebei-domiciled foreign private issuer (formerly TCTM Kids IT Education/Tarena), filed a 6-K reporting completion of a private placement originally signed July 10, 2026 and re-signed October 10, 2026. The company issued 125,000,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.001 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of US$125,000,000, up from the prior $0.000734 price and roughly $91.75 million total. Purchasers paid in fiat or cryptocurrency at the company's discretion; securities relied on Section 4(a)(2) and/or Regulation S. No advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock is disclosed. Watch for massive dilution and crypto-settlement transparency.
